_note: Aggregator feeds worth polling, with robots.txt compliance recorded per source. Verified 2026-08-18. The scanner MUST honour crawl_delay and MUST NOT poll any source marked allowed:false - several major job boards explicitly disallow automated job-appliers in robots.txt, and their terms prohibit scraping regardless.

sources.name: firerecruitment.ca
sources.coverage: BC, AB, SK, ON and beyond - the dominant Canadian fire-recruitment aggregator
sources.feed: per-user personalised RSS plus email alerts (needs a free account)
sources.notes: HIGHEST-VALUE SOURCE. Running 12+ years, 8,000+ members, postings dated within days of check. Covers Alberta properly. Sandra should register for the email alerts herself regardless of what the engine does - it is the closest thing to a single national feed for fire jobs.

sources.name: Government of Canada Job Bank
sources.robots: User-agent: * / Crawl-delay: 5 with ZERO Disallow lines - the most permissive source checked
sources.notes: NOC 2021 code for firefighters is 42101. Fully permissive robots.txt, so this is the cleanest legal polling target available.

sources.name: firefighterrecruitments.ca
sources.notes: Second aggregator. Ontario-heavy so lower value from Alberta, but open and worth a low-frequency poll.

sources.name: Alberta Municipalities job board
sources.notes: Real municipal board with ~48 live postings. Careful: abmunis.ca/careers is a DIFFERENT thing - that is the association's own internal staff jobs on Dayforce, not the municipal board. Easy trap.

sources.name: Rural Municipalities of Alberta
sources.coverage: Alberta rural municipal - directly relevant to county paid-on-call roles
sources.robots: Plain WordPress - only /wp-admin/ blocked; sitemap at /wp-sitemap.xml
sources.notes: Rural counties are exactly where paid-on-call firefighter roles live, so this board is better matched to Sandra than the urban ones.

sources.name: Alberta Fire Chiefs Association
sources.notes: Career Opportunities sit under the Command Post menu, but postings seen were command-level only (Fire Chief, Assistant Chief) rather than entry firefighter. Low value now, high value in ten years.

sources.name: Indeed Canada
sources.robots: Disallow /job/, /jobs/CA/, /viewjob? for generic agents; Scrapy named and blocked site-wide; terms separately prohibit scraping
sources.notes: DO NOT POLL. Indeed's robots.txt leaves no path for a generically-identified automated job tool to fetch listings or job pages. Sandra can of course browse and apply by hand - the restriction is on automation, not on her.

sources.name: LinkedIn
sources.notes: DO NOT POLL. Manual use only.

sources.name: Glassdoor
sources.robots: Named AI agents restricted to /Award/ and /About/ only; job paths off-limits
sources.notes: DO NOT POLL. Manual use only.

sources.name: CivicInfo BC
sources.coverage: BC municipal - the official BC local-government job board
sources.robots: Cloudflare Content-Signal ai-train=no; ClaudeBot, GPTBot and others named and disallowed; /careers returns 403 to automated fetchers
sources.notes: DO NOT POLL. Only relevant if Sandra ever looks at BC anyway. LGMA BC confirms this IS the BC board - there is no separate one.
